paragraphs: Rav Chaviva. Rav, Rabbi Chanina, Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Chaviva teach throughout Order Moed (see there). Rav Yeimar and Ravina: Chullin 51a. This requires examination: although Ravina may be the earlier one, how could Rav Chaviva, in Yochanan’s and Chanina’s generation, be in Rav Yeimar’s generation of Rav Ashi’s days? Perhaps the Chaviva with Yeimar and Ravina is the son of Rav Yosef son of Rava mentioned below, in Rav Ashi’s time and that of the second Rav Kahana, Rav Ashi’s teacher. Or Chaviva of Mechoza, in Rav Ashi’s generation.
